boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on Highland Falls’ Main Street corridor and the adjacent South Post approach, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: West Point Museum — public military-history exhibits
cards.subtitle: New South Post Road, beside the Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the South Post approach to the public museum and use the galleries to connect Academy, Army, and military-history artifacts with the place itself.
cards.short_summary: A public museum focused on West Point, the Army, and the profession of arms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Army Museum Enterprise identifies the West Point Museum as a public institution that collects, preserves, exhibits, and interprets artifacts relating to USMA, the U.S. Army, and the profession of arms; admission is free.
cards.source_title: West Point Museum — U.S. Army Center of Military History
cards.access_notes: 2110 New South Post Rd.; listed hours are Tuesday–Sunday, 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.; closed Mondays and specified holidays.

cards.title: Highland Falls Library — books, study areas, and programs
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 298 Main Street
cards.notes: Use the library’s adult study areas, internet computers, catalog, or community-room programming; check its calendar before making a dedicated trip.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street library serving Highland Falls, Fort Montgomery, and West Point courtesy users.
cards.evidence_claim: The library says its 2001 building includes adult book and study areas, internet computers, an online catalog, and a community room for meetings, programs, and art displays.
cards.source_title: History of Our Library — Highland Falls Library
cards.access_notes: 298 Main Street; municipal listing gives Tuesday hours until 7 p.m. and other weekday/Saturday hours.

cards.title: Town Hall — public records and local-government access
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 254 Main Street
cards.notes: Stop during office hours if you need public town documents or want a practical anchor for understanding the Town of Highlands’ local services.
cards.short_summary: The town-government office holding official documents and public records.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town Clerk states that official town documents, including board minutes, agreements, resolutions, Town Code, and local laws, are kept in this office and available to the public.
cards.access_notes: 254 Main Street; Town Clerk hours are listed as Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.

cards.title: Hacienda Restaurant — Mexican, Spanish, and Latin American menu
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 145 Main Street
cards.notes: Use the posted menu to choose a pickup, delivery, or dine-in meal, and confirm the day’s service window before heading down Main Street.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant with Mexican, Spanish, and Latin American dishes.
cards.evidence_claim: Hacienda’s official site lists 145 Main Street and describes its menu as Mexican, Spanish, and Latin American, including enchiladas, chimichangas, quesadillas, and tacos.
cards.access_notes: 145 Main Street; the site lists takeout hours and pickup/delivery ordering.

cards.title: Brother’s Pizza — dine-in or takeout pizza and sandwiches
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 233 Main Street
cards.notes: Choose dine-in or carryout from the pizza, sandwich, calzone, and salad menu; the restaurant says it does not offer delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizzeria with dine-in and carryout service.
cards.evidence_claim: Brother’s Pizza lists its Highland Falls location at 233 Main Street and says its menu includes thin-crust and Sicilian pizzas, salads, sandwiches, and calzones.
cards.access_notes: 233 Main Street; listed hours are Monday–Friday 11 a.m.–8 p.m. and Saturday noon–8 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Grandma’s Bagels & Pizza — morning-to-evening counter stop
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 265 Main Street
cards.notes: Plan a quick Main Street meal around the posted 7 a.m.–6 p.m. service window, and use the menu for bagels, pizza, sandwiches, or salads.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street shop listing bagels, pizza, and a broad casual-food menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Grandma’s Bagels & Pizza lists 265 Main Street and a menu that includes pizza, salads, sandwiches, calzones, and breakfast items.
cards.access_notes: 265 Main Street; the official ordering site displays 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. service information.

cards.title: Andy’s Restaurant — early breakfast and lunch hours
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 281 Main Street
cards.notes: Use this stop for a daytime meal when the early schedule fits; check the posted holiday caveat before relying on a specific opening time.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street restaurant with early daytime service.
cards.evidence_claim: Andy’s official site lists the restaurant at 281 Main Street and publishes hours beginning at 6:00 a.m., with service ending between 2:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. depending on the day.
cards.source_title: Andy's Restaurant — Reviews and Contact Information
cards.access_notes: 281 Main Street; posted hours vary by day and may vary on holidays.

cards.title: West Point Pizza — delivery or Main Street pickup
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 282 Main Street
cards.notes: Use online ordering for pickup or delivery, or visit the Main Street location; the business says it delivers to West Point, Highland Falls, and parts of Fort Montgomery.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizza restaurant serving the West Point and Highland Falls area.
cards.evidence_claim: West Point Pizza lists 282 Main Street, states it is open daily from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m., and says it offers delivery to West Point, Highland Falls, and some of Fort Montgomery.
cards.access_notes: 282 Main Street; official site lists daily hours of 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Bear Mountain Bakery — bakery counter on Main Street
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 307 Main Street
cards.notes: Make this a daytime food stop and verify the day’s hours before leaving; the bakery’s own contact page provides the address and weekly schedule.
cards.short_summary: A bakery at 307 Main Street with published daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Bear Mountain Bakery’s official contact page lists its address as 307 Main Street, Highland Falls, and provides hours for each day of the week.
cards.access_notes: 307 Main Street; the business lists 8:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m. Monday–Saturday, with Sunday hours shown separately.

cards.title: The Wintermarket — Saturday produce, flowers, and books
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — 401 Main Street
cards.notes: Time this stop for the Saturday indoor market season and browse vendors offering fresh produce, flowers, and books at the stated Main Street location.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal Saturday indoor farmers’ market in Highland Falls.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wintermarket identifies 401 Main Street as its location and says vendors offer fresh produce, flowers, and books; it lists Saturday hours from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. from November to May.
cards.access_notes: 401 Main Street; listed schedule is Saturdays, 10:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m., November through May.
